France–Singapore BIT (in force) covering ASEAN regional expansion

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Articles L561-1 to L561-38, L561-2-3 and L562-1 et seq. of the French Code monétaire et financier (CMF); Articles R561-1 et seq. CMF; Decree No. 2016-1632 establishing the French beneficial owner register (Registre des bénéficiaires effectifs) administered by INPI; implementation of EU Directive (EU) 2015/849 as amended by (EU) 2018/843 and (EU) 2020/xxxx; enforcement and financial intelligence functions exercised by TRACFIN; registration via the Guichet unique de l'INPI.
ubo_and_aml_profiling.ubo_disclosure_level: Government_Only_Access (restricted access: competent authorities, TRACFIN, obliged AML/CFT entities conducting CDD, and persons demonstrating a legitimate interest under the post-ECJ C-37/20 regime; no fully public register access)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of incorporation of the foreign corporate shareholder (extrait d'immatriculation)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent company registry of the shareholder's domicile jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (where the shareholder jurisdiction is a Hague Convention state) or Consular Legalization (non-Hague jurisdiction)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of good standing / no insolvency proceedings (certificat de non-inscription en procédure collective)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Company registry or insolvency official of the shareholder's domicile jurisdiction

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Beneficial owner register extract of the foreign corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Beneficial ownership registry or corporate registry of the shareholder's domicile jurisdiction

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized power of attorney granted to the French legal representative and counsel
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary of the shareholder's domicile jurisdiction

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified passport copies of the legal representative, managers and ultimate beneficial owners
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Passport-issuing competent authority of each individual's jurisdiction

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all legal representatives, managers, beneficial owners and material contracting counterparties against: (i) the French DG Trésor financial sanctions and asset-freezing list, (ii) the EU consolidated financial sanctions list (Council Regulation (EU) No 753/2011 and associated CFSP acts), (iii) UN Security Council sanctions regimes, and (iv) the OFAC SDN/Non-SDN lists where the SARL adopts US-based payment rails (Stripe) and US EHR interoperability standards; PEPs are identified under EU AML standards and subjected to enhanced due diligence (Article L561-10-2 CMF); TRACFIN reporting obligations apply to any unusual or suspicious transaction arising during incorporation and ongoing operation.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Guichet unique de l'INPI – Registre National des Entreprises (RNE) via formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr; preliminary distinctiveness search via INPI data portal and Infogreffe
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The company name (dénomination sociale) must be written in Latin characters; it may be in French or another language, but any non-French name must be accompanied by a sworn French translation/transliteration for all official publications and registry filings; Article R123-44 of the French Code de commerce governs the distinctiveness of the name against existing companies, protected trademarks and prior domain names; foreign-language documents supporting the name clearance must be translated by a court-accredited translator (traducteur agréé)
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Banque, Banquier, Assurance, Assureur, Mutuelle, Courtier, Fiduciaire
Médecin, Chirurgien, Pharmacie, Clinique, Hôpital, Cabinet Médical, Dispensaire
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: If the Guichet unique/INPI rejects the proposed name due to lack of distinctiveness or prohibited tokens, the applicant must file a corrective submission through the same INPI portal using a revised name set without incurring an additional formation filing fee for the first correction; pursuant to Article R123-57 of the Code de commerce, the applicant may in writing require the registrar (Greffier) to reconsider the refusal; if the refusal is upheld, the applicant may refer the matter to the President of the Commercial Court (Tribunal de commerce) of the registered office or, failing a commercial court, to the competent Tribunal judiciaire, which shall rule in urgent chamber proceedings; a fresh name availability search certificate must accompany any resubmission and remains valid for 30 days.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Commercial domiciliation is specifically permitted for SARLs under Articles L123-11-1 and L123-11-2 of the Code de commerce through an authorized domiciliation company; however, for a medical EMR SaaS operating in the clinical health-data sector, the French Public Health Code (Article L1111-8 CSP) and the ARS (Agence Régionale de Santé) require an operational establishment and a certified Health Data Hosting (HDS) declaration, so a purely virtual office without demonstrable management and service substance poses a compliance acceptance risk for this industry.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: 10–15% quantified risk of unannounced on-site verification of the registered office and factual substance by the Greffe or URSSAF; 25% quantified risk of an ARS/CNIL inspection once the EMR software processes health data or connects to certified HDS infrastructure, including checks on patient data confidentiality, medical workflow integrity and subcontractor chain.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Publication of legal incorporation notice (annonce légale) in an approved Journal d'Annonces Légales

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: French Commercial Code (Code de commerce), Book II, Title III, Articles L. 223-1 to L. 223-43 (SARL regime), supplemented by Articles L. 210-1 to L. 210-10 (general company provisions), R. 223-1 et seq., and R. 123-1 et seq. (Register of Commerce and Companies / RCS rules)
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce (Registry of the Commercial Court) territorially competent; filings are intermediated by the Guichet Unique des Formalités des Entreprises (INSEE online portal: formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr)
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Déclaration de constitution d'une société (M0 electronic declaration) filed through the Guichet Unique, together with the signed articles of association (statuts), the bank capital-deposit certificate, the legal-publication certificate, and the beneficial-owner declaration; RCS enrolment is evidenced by the official Extrait Kbis
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum share capital is imposed for an SARL (a €1 or higher amount may be chosen), but the entire stated capital must be subscribed. Where the stated capital exceeds €300, at least 1/5 of each cash contribution must be paid up at incorporation and the balance must be called within five years (Art. L. 223-7 C. com.). The paid-up funds must be escrowed in a blocked account held by a French bank, the Caisse des Dépôts et Consignations, or a notary until the company obtains its Kbis (Art. L. 223-8 C. com.).
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: FIRST SHAREHOLDERS' RESOLUTION OF [COMPANY NAME], SARL — DATED [DATE]. The shareholders, acting unanimously, hereby resolve: (1) to approve the subscription of [100] ordinary shares, par value €[1.00] each, constituting €[100.00] share capital; (2) to confirm the escrow deposit of the statutory paid-up portion with [BANK] and to authorise its release solely upon issue of the Kbis; (3) to adopt as registered office [ADDRESS], France; (4) to appoint [NAME] as Gérant, with the widest powers to manage the company and to execute the M0 registration; and (5) to authorise the Gérant to file all statutory declarations and health-data licensing applications. This resolution is effective immediately.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting and Execution of the Articles of Association (Statuts)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Founding shareholders, assisted by a qualified lawyer or drafted in private writing (acte sous seing privé); a notaire is mandatory only for in-kind contributions comprising real estate or a business unit (fonds de commerce).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare the statuts constitutifs in the French language. Include the company form (SARL), corporate object covering the publishing and operation of medical EMR and clinical workflow SaaS software (NAF/APE code 6201Z), duration (max. 99 years), amount and division of share capital, distribution of shares, registered-office address, and the identity and powers of the first gérant. Each shareholder must sign and initial every page; the share-subscription statement is appended. If any in-kind asset, real property or goodwill is contributed, appoint a statutory asset-valuation auditor (commissaire aux apports) as required by Article L. 223-9 C. com.
required_dossiers: Final articles of association (statuts) executed by all shareholders
Share-subscription statement
Valuation report of the commissaire aux apports, if any in-kind contribution
Identity documents of each shareholder and of the gérant
Declaration of non-conviction (déclaration de non-condamnation) of the gérant
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the statutory formalities are challenged by the greffe or by a notary, a signed rectification (errata/avenant) must be adopted by all shareholders; if the appointment of the commissaire aux apports was omitted, commission one before filing.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Deposit of the Paid-Up Share Capital in a Blocked Escrow Account
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: A French commercial bank, the Caisse des Dépôts et Consignations (CDC), or a notary serving as escrow agent.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a temporary blocked account in the name of the company en formation. Transfer the paid-up fraction of each cash contribution (at least 1/5 of stated capital where capital exceeds €300; any amount if capital is €300 or less). The escrow agent issues a certificate of capital deposit (attestation de dépôt des fonds). The funds must remain blocked and may not be withdrawn until the company presents its RCS registration certificate (Kbis). The gérant must sign the escrow instruction setting the authorised signatories and the release condition.
required_dossiers: Draft or final statuts
Identity documents and declaration of beneficial owners
Bank-account opening form and AML/KYC questionnaire
Escrow-release mandate
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank refuses the account, verify source-of-funds documentation or retain a notarial escrow; if the certificate contains an error, obtain a corrected attestation before filing the M0 dossier.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Publication of the Legal Incorporation Notice (Avis de Constitution)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: A publication outlet authorised as a journal d'annonces légales (JAL) in the department of the registered office.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Instruct the JAL to publish a constitutional notice stating: the corporate name, legal form (SARL), share capital, registered office, corporate object, anticipated duration, and the identity of the gérant; where applicable, the notary designated for the deposit. Collect the publisher's attestation de parution (proof of publication), to be included in the incorporation file.
required_dossiers: Full text of the avis de constitution
Power of attorney or instruction letter to the JAL
Identity confirmation of the filing agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notice differs from the final statuts, publish a corrigendum on the same JAL and attach it to the dossier; if the publication is delayed, request the JAL's electronic proof of issue.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Electronic Filing of the Incorporation Dossier with the Guichet Unique / RCS
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Guichet Unique des Formalités des Entreprises (INSEE portal: formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr), automatically routed to the RCS (Registre du commerce et des sociétés) kept by the Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Complete the electronic M0 declaration: select SARL legal form and NAF/APE code 6201Z (computer programming); enter the corporate name, registered office, capital, duration, corporate object and legal representatives; declare the beneficial owners; upload the statuts, bank capital-deposit certificate, JAL publication certificate, identity documents and any valuation reports; pay the greffe registration fees by bank card; retain the electronic receipt (récepissé de dépôt).
required_dossiers: Electronic M0 declaration
Signed articles of association (statuts)
Capital certificate (attestation de dépôt des fonds)
Proof of legal publication (attestation de parution)
Proof of registered-office address (domiciliation)
Identity card, declaration of non-conviction and address proof of the gérant
Declaration of beneficial owners (UBO)
Power of attorney if filed through an agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: The greffe issues a query (demande de complément) where the dossier is incomplete; cure it within fifteen days through the same portal by adding corrected or supplementary documents before the file is closed; alternatively, submit an amended constitution file with corporate rectification.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Registration on the RCS and Issuance of the Kbis Extract
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce (Registry), territorially competent for the registered office.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The Registry verifies legal compliance (capacity, statutory formalities, gérant's declaration, capital rules) and records the company in the RCS register. The company then obtains the Extrait Kbis — the official certificate of existence identifying the SIREN and SIRET numbers, the NAF 6201Z code, share capital, statutory officials and the registered office. The Kbis constitutes the legal identity card required for all banking, contracting, invoicing and health-data licensing steps.
required_dossiers: The complete M0 dossier already transmitted (no supplemental dossier required)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If registration is refused, verify the reasons stated in the Registry notice and rectify the statutory articles; the Registry's refusal may be contested before the President of the Commercial Court within fifteen days; any clerical error in the Kbis is cured by an endorsed rectification request.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Activation of the Permanent Corporate Bank Account and Release of Escrow Funds
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: The corporate bank that maintained the initial blocked account, or a newly selected French bank servicing SARLs.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Present the official Kbis, the registered statuts and the gérant's appointment to the bank. The bank converts the blocked account into the company's current account, releases the escrowed capital and issues the company RIB. Complete the bank's corporate KYC/AML questionnaire, sign the account-operation mandates (authorised signatories) and register the electronic banking signature for the gérant. The company is now operational for billing and payroll purposes.
required_dossiers: Official Kbis extract
Registered articles of association (statuts)
Identity and residence proof of the gérant
Ultimate beneficial ownership statement
Company activity description and expected invoice volume
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank exercises its right to refuse banking services, file a procédure du droit au compte (right-to-an-account) with the Banque de France to designate an account-holding institution; escalate compliance objections to the bank's legal-entity team.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Agence du Numérique en Santé (ANS) — certification and Ségur conformity procedures; Commission Nationale de l'Informatique et des Libertés (CNIL) for health-data protection; Direction Générale de la Santé (DGS) for health-software oversight; regional DREAL/DRIEAT and ADEME for any environmental obligations of the physical premises.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Certification Hébergeur de Données de Santé (HDS) (Code de la santé publique, art. L. 1111-8, and HDS implementing regulation) where health data are hosted; conformity registration of the EMR software to the Référentiel Ségur du numérique en santé (SI-Ségur) for interoperability with French regional health information systems; CNIL compliance file (GDPR, data-protection impact assessment) as a health-data controller/processor.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: ADEME (Agence de l'environnement et de la maîtrise de l'énergie); for any classifiable installation, the DREAL/DRIEAT territorial authority under the Code de l'environnement (ICPE regime).
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt — pure SaaS/office activity is not an Installation Classée pour la Protection de l'Environnement (ICPE) and does not trigger a full Environmental Impact Assessment (EIA) under Article R. 122-2 of the Code de l'environnement; a registration/notice regime only applies if the site installs standby power generators, fuel tanks above 2,500 litres, or server rooms exceeding the ICPE declaration thresholds.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No process wastewater or process VOC emissions result from the office/software activity; only sanitary effluents are discharged and must comply with municipal sewerage bylaws (e.g. pH 6.0–9.5, BOD5 < 600 mg/L, COD < 1,000 mg/L, TSS < 600 mg/L); electrical and electronic waste (WEEE/DEEE) must be recycled through registered eco-organisations under EU Directive 2012/19/EU and Articles R. 543-172 et seq. of the Code de l'environnement; any on-site cooling and data-centre equipment must respect EU F-gas Regulation 517/2014 (refrigerant GWP below 2,500, annual leak checks) and the EN 50600 energy-efficiency and cooling standards for data centres; building noise at the property boundary must remain below 65 dB(A) in daytime and 55 dB(A) at night per ICPE municipal noise references.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Offices must pass the fire-safety compliance set out in the French Code de l'incendie (smoke detectors, fire extinguishers, emergency exits, evacuation signage, and an annual inspection certificate issued by a certified fire-safety body, renewed per ERP standards where the premises are open to the public); occupational health compliance requires compulsory preparation of the Document Unique d'Évaluation des Risques Professionnels (DUER), display of first-aid and evacuation instructions, maintenance of the workplace-safety register, and access to the occupational health service (médecine du travail) under Articles L. 4121-1 et seq. and R. 4227-1 et seq. of the Code du travail; electrical installations must be certified conforming by an approved body (Consuel attestation). Premises accessibility for disabled persons (PMR) must be demonstrated under Law 2005-102 and the Construction and Housing Code; structural stability of floors (e.g. > 250 kg/m² for server rooms) must be attested by the lessor's structural engineer or by a civil-defence inspection where the lease requires it.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Direction Générale des Finances Publiques (DGFiP), Service des Impôts des Entreprises (SIE); official portal: impots.gouv.fr; non-resident VAT registration handled by Service des Impôts des Entreprises Étrangères (SIEE), Paris.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A French SARL receives SIREN/SIRET and VAT intra-community identification automatically upon company incorporation via INPI and the Registre du Commerce et des Sociétés (RCS). A foreign entity without a French establishment must file form 16216-SD (Demande d'immatriculation) with the SIEE to obtain a French VAT number, submitting proof of foreign registration, authenticating statutory documents, and a local fiscal representative where required; processing typically 2–4 weeks; online submission via impots.gouv.fr or the Guichet Entreprises.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Small-sized SARLs (turnover below €10M, services below €5M, ≤50 employees, ≥75% individual shareholders) may elect pass-through taxation at the shareholder level under CGI Art. 239 bis AA, revocable within the statutory period; no US-style check-the-box exists; hybrid mismatch outcomes derive from mandatory ATAD-aligned provisions operative by law, not elective.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: VAT (Taxe sur la Valeur Ajoutée – TVA)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: EUR 25,000 annual service turnover (basic franchise en base de TVA); mandatory registration above EUR 25,000 for service providers; voluntary option for actual VAT regime below threshold is available.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory structured e-invoicing (Facturation Électronique) in force: phased obligations from 1 Sep 2026 for large and mid-size enterprises, 1 Sep 2027 for SMEs/VSEs; all establishments must be able to receive e-invoices from 1 Sep 2026; e-reporting of transaction data to DGFiP via certified Partner Dematerialization Platform (PDP) or the Portail Public de Facturation (PPF); accepted formats Factur-X / UBL; no real-time digital stamping, but structured transmission and data clearance occur through the approved exchange network.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: 0% export VAT exemption for tangible goods exported outside the EU under CGI Art. 262-I-1° with physical proof of export; intra-community supplies of goods to EU VAT-registered buyers exempt under Art. 262 ter with valid EU VAT IDs; for SaaS/EMR services, B2B supplies to non-French established customers fall outside French VAT by place-of-supply rule (CGI Art. 259A), and B2C supplies to non-EU consumers are outside French VAT; EU B2C digital services are taxable at destination via OSS, not export zero-rating; input VAT refund on export costs via French VAT refund procedure (Directive 2008/9/EC for EU, 13th Directive for non-EU).
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Déclaration en Douane / DAU) filed via DELTA-X or ECS electronic system
Commercial Invoice and executed SaaS/EMR license or services contract
Bill of Lading, Air Waybill, or CMR transport document for hardware/embedded tangible components
Foreign customer VAT registration certificate (EU intra-community) or non-EU tax residency certificate
Bank Inward Remittance Certificate / incoming payment proof (Avis de Crédit) from the foreign purchaser
Digital service delivery evidence (usage logs, server delivery location, order records) for audit substantiation
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Unsubstantiated or fraudulent zero-rating triggers DGFiP VAT reassessment plus intérêts de retard at 0.2% per month; 40% penalty for incorrect declarations; 80% for deliberate suppression of documents or concealment; 100% for abusive manipulation; criminal tax fraud (CGI Art. 1741) punishable by up to EUR 500,000 fine and seven years’ imprisonment; retroactive clawback of input VAT deductions, loss of export-related credits, joint and several liability of installer and foreign customer (CGI Art. 283) in VAT evasion chains.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banque de France (within the Eurosystem; the French authority for balance-of-payments reporting, monetary policy execution and financial stability supervision, utilising the framework of the European Central Bank)
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: France applies EU free movement of capital; the euro is a fully convertible currency. Current-account convertibility is unrestricted; capital-account transactions are liberalised, with only statistical reporting obligations. Dividend repatriation from a French SARL is permitted following approval of the statutory accounts at the annual general meeting and verification of distributable profit. Practical hurdles are the documentary evidence required by the remitting bank to prove the distribution is lawful, and non-resident dividend withholding tax under domestic law (potentially up to 25% for corporate shareholders, or the 30% flat levy for individuals), reduced by available tax treaties and the parent-subsidiary directive exemption where applicable.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: France has no mandatory export-proceeds surrender requirement, no minimum conversion ratio and no statutory repatriation timeline for export receipts. Exporters retain proceeds in foreign currency or convert to euro at their discretion. However, balance-of-payments statistical declarations to Banque de France apply to transactions exceeding EUR 12,500 per month, and the receiving bank must report the transaction. No conversion ratios are applicable under the French Foreign Exchange Regulation (Code monétaire et financier).

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Crédit Agricole SA / Crédit Agricole Corporate and Investment Bank

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Viability rating: High for a French-domiciled SARL with a verified gérant. French fintech EMI providers (e.g., Qonto, Anytime) offer efficient corporate onboarding and multi-currency IBANs for cross-border SaaS operations, subject to full ACPR licensing and the EMIR's compliance with Low_Risk_Standard. A cross-border EMI authorised under the EEA passporting regime may provide services in France if it holds a valid e-money or payment institution licence from another EU/EEA regulator and complies with ACPR oversight. Legal constraints include the prohibition on EMIs granting credit, mandatory segregation of client funds, and the requirement that the ultimate beneficial ownership structure be completely transparent; if health-related payment data is processed, the institution must also comply with the French Health Data Hosting (HDS) framework where applicable.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: French traditional banks and most fintech EMIs require the legal representative(s) (gérant) to complete an in-person onboarding interview, though remote identification via certified video-process is increasingly accepted for EU/EEA identity documents. For non-resident gérants without a French suitability check, a physical appointment at the bank branch, or at a French notary/consulate, is commonly required, together with apostilled corporate and identity documentation. The SARL must also provide the certified actual beneficiary (UBO) declaration and proof of authority of the signatory.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Health-data software business raises elevated data protection and sector risk due to GDPR and the French Loi Informatique et Libertés classification of electronic medical records as health data (catégorie particulière).
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Privacy and GDPR compliance file: data processing register, data protection impact analysis (DPIA), prior CNIL authorisation where required, Article 28 processing contracts with customers, ISO 27001 and HDS certification, and evidence of EU-based data hosting.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Complex corporate ownership, non-resident UBOs or distributed shareholding increases money-laundering risk and requires proof of the source and legitimacy of funds.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Corporate structure chart, UBO declaration form, chain-of-title statements, certificate of good standing for each foreign entity in the group, identity documents of all UBOs, evidence of source of wealth (audited financial statements, bank references), parent-entity resolutions authorising the French SARL incorporation, and tax-residence declarations for every beneficial owner.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Cross-border payment flows to non-treaty jurisdictions or offshore financial centres may trigger sanctions screening and adverse-media checks.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Counterparty due-diligence file: risk-based trade matrix, sanctions and PEP screening results for all counterparties, commercial contracts proving market-priced transactions, invoices, debt-collection terms, and the internal AML-FT policy (directives, training records, risk assessment) for medical SaaS customers, including reinforced due-diligence documentation for high-risk jurisdictions.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound equity or shareholder loans to the French SARL must be wired via SWIFT MT103 or intra-EU SEPA transfer, using the French payment purpose code 'C120' (apport en capital) or appropriate code for capital contributions. For non-EU transfers, conversion to EUR is done at the receiving bank. The remitting bank must attach the French SIREN/SIRET, an extract of the trade register (extrait Kbis), minutes of the shareholders/manager resolution, the capital deposit certificate, and a clear narrative identifying the shareholder and the purpose. If the contribution exceeds EUR 12,500, the Banque de France balance-of-payments reporting obligation rests with the bank; the company should retain all supporting documentation for internal review.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: The principal clearing rails are SWIFT MT103 and SEPA instant payments for salary, supplier and intercompany disbursements. For tangible medical device or any ancillary goods-related settlements, a commercial letter of credit (documentary credit) may be established through French banks; however, for a pure EMR SaaS company, bank transfers via SWIFT MT103 or SEPA CT are preferred. All non-EUR payments are cleared via Paris correspondent banks with FX conversion at the mandated bank rate. Monthly balance-of-payments declarations for aggregated flows exceeding EUR 12,500 must be filed to Banque de France by the bank or the company, as applicable.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Non-Deliverable Forwards (NDFs) for currencies without deliverable spot markets

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Approval of annual financial statements by the Ordinary General Meeting (AGO) of the SARL
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Internal corporate act; signed minutes retained in the statutory minute book and, where relevant, considered by the Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce in the annual accounts filing
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 6 months of the balance-sheet date / fiscal year-end
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to convene the AGO prevents timely filing of annual accounts and constitutes a management deficiency exposing the manager to civil liability; persistent default may trigger a court injunction and ultimately a judicial dissolution of the SARL.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual statutory accounts filing with the Register of Commerce and Companies (dépôt des comptes annuels au RCS)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce, submitted electronically through the INPI Guichet Unique
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 1 month of AGO approval and in any case no later than 7 months after fiscal year-end
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: The greffier issues a formal injunction after the deadline; continued non-compliance may attract a coercive monetary penalty fixed by the court and may lead to judicial strike-off of the company from the RCS.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual corporate income tax return (liasse fiscale IS, form package 2065-SD)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Direction Générale des Finances Publiques (DGFiP), via EDI or EFI online filing
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 3 months of the balance-sheet date; for a 31 December year-end, filing deadline is 15 May of the following calendar year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing triggers late-interest at 0.20% per month and a late-filing penalty of 10% after a 30-day notice; failure to report profits may attract penalties up to 40%-80%; each omitted supporting schedule is subject to a fixed fine of EUR 100.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Beneficial-ownership register update and confirmation (Registre des bénéficiaires effectifs - RBE)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce through the INPI Guichet Unique
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 30 days of any share transfer, change of control, or change in beneficial-ownership data; annual verification at the AGO
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: False, incomplete, or late UBO declarations may be punished by up to 6 months' imprisonment and fines up to EUR 3,750 for managers and EUR 18,750 for the SARL; the RCS may reject linked filings until the RBE is corrected.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory appointment of a statutory auditor (commissaire aux comptes) is required if the SARL exceeds at least two of the following three thresholds at the balance-sheet date: total balance sheet greater than EUR 4,000,000; net turnover excluding VAT greater than EUR 8,000,000; average workforce greater than 50 employees. A court-appointed auditor may also be required on the petition of shareholders representing at least 10% of the capital.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: French GAAP (Plan Comptable Général) under ANC Regulation 2014-03, transposing EU Accounting Directive 2013/34/EU; IFRS is not permitted for standalone SARL statutory annual accounts.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: France imposes a continuing beneficial-ownership register obligation, not a standalone annual UBO filing. The RBE must be filed or updated via the INPI Guichet Unique within 30 days after any share transfer or change in direct or indirect beneficial ownership. As an annual corporate-secretarial protocol, the manager verifies the RBE against the members register at each ordinary general meeting, records any adjustment in the minutes, and files an updated RBE only when a change has occurred.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members (registre des associés and parts sociales)
Register of Directors/Managers and corporate decisions (registre des mandats sociaux and décisions)
Minute Book (registre des procès-verbaux des assemblées et décisions)

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 25% (standard rate; reduced 15% on first €38,120 of profit for SMEs with turnover ≤ €10 million)
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Reduced rate for small and medium enterprises; Research Tax Credit (CIR) for R&D expenditures; Innovation Tax Credit (CII) for SMEs; territorial economic development incentives

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Form 2065 (and annexes 2065-A to 2065-SD) filed via the official French tax portal (impots.gouv.fr)
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: For fiscal year ending December 31, the return must be filed by May 3 of the following year (online filing mandatory for companies with turnover > €50,000; paper filing deadline May 15).

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Résultat fiscal (taxable profit or loss before adjustments)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident companies must report French-source income and may be required to appoint a tax representative in France.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Bénéfice imposable (taxable income after deductions and reliefs)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Apply treaty provisions and ensure proper allocation of income to French permanent establishment if applicable.
Losses from French operations may be carried forward indefinitely, subject to annual limitation rules.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Crédits d'impôts (tax credits, e.g., CIR, CII)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-residents may claim credits only if they have a permanent establishment in France.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing: 5% of tax due plus 0.5% per month of delay (capped at 10%). Late payment: 0.2% per month of unpaid tax. Additional penalties for fraudulent filing (up to 80% of tax due).

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 30% (standard rate for non-resident shareholders; reduced to 0% under EU Parent-Subsidiary Directive if holding ≥10% for 2 years; treaty rates may apply)
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: To claim reduced withholding tax, the non-resident shareholder must submit a completed Form 5000 (or Form 5001 for individuals) along with a valid Tax Residency Certificate (TRC) to the French tax authority before the payment date. If over-withheld, a refund claim must be filed within the statutory limitation period (generally until December 31 of the second year following the payment).
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Royalties: statutory 33.33% (reduced to 0% under EU Interest & Royalties Directive if beneficial owner is an EU affiliate; treaty rates often 0-10%). Interest: statutory 30% (reduced under treaties, e.g., 0% under EU Interest & Royalties Directive; treaty rates typically 0-10%).

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Full Local File and Master File required if group consolidated revenue exceeds €400 million. For smaller entities, basic TP documentation (including a functional analysis and arm's length justification) must be maintained.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: France applies general anti-abuse rules (GAAR) and substance-over-form principles. While no specific Economic Substance Regulations (ESR) exist, the French tax administration scrutinizes entities lacking real economic activity, employees, and premises. A SARL must demonstrate genuine business purpose and substance to avoid recharacterization.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Deliberate understatement of taxable income, false accounting, or concealment of revenue (e.g., unreported SaaS subscriptions).
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Criminal penalties: fine up to €500,000 and imprisonment up to 5 years (Article 1741 CGI). Civil penalties: 40% to 80% of understated tax plus interest.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors may be held personally liable for unpaid corporate taxes if they participated in fraudulent acts (action en comblement de passif). Travel bans and asset freezes may be imposed.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating as a conduit with no real economic substance, employees, or business activity; artificially shifting profits to low-tax jurisdictions.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Recharacterization of transactions, denial of treaty benefits, and imposition of 40% penalty for lack of substance (Article 155-A CGI).
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors may be held jointly liable for unpaid taxes and penalties if they knowingly facilitated the artificial arrangement. Criminal charges for tax fraud may apply.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failure to implement AML procedures (e.g., customer due diligence, transaction monitoring) despite being a financial services provider; processing funds from illegal sources.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Administrative fines up to €5 million or 5% of annual turnover; criminal penalties for money laundering up to 5 years imprisonment and €375,000 fine (Articles 324-1 et seq. Penal Code).
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors can face personal criminal liability, including imprisonment and fines, if they knowingly participate in or fail to prevent money laundering. Civil liability for damages to third parties.
